- Open phone Settings and disable Battery Optimization for Curax. - Enable Auto-start/Background activity permission for Curax (on supported phones). - Keep lock-screen notifications allowed for Curax. - Allow mobile data and background data for Curax. - Turn off Data Saver for Curax (or allow unrestricted data). - Do not Force Stop the app from phone settings. - After reinstall or app data clear, open app and tap Connect again to register a new FCM token. - Keep Google Play Services enabled and updated. - Use Export chat history from Settings when needed.
Health Hub admin on this phone

This Curax app mode is for administrators who run a Health Hub: you invite or approve users, see hub alerts, review reports, and can open someone\'s schedule when they need help (Care mode). It is not the same as the standard patient or user home — the bottom tabs and drawer are built around roster management and oversight.

• Dashboard — snapshot counts, charts, recent activity, and shortcuts into other tabs. • Users — everyone linked to your hub, their mode (default vs standalone), relay or desktop readiness, Care mode, and refresh. • Alerts — filterable list of alerts for your workspace. • Reports — exports (for example CSV or PDF) and analytics views. • Connections — pending link requests, refresh, and your invite or connection code to share so people can join your hub.

Open the navigation drawer from the toolbar menu for relay connection status, shortcuts, and the same roster context as the Users tab. Connect the relay when you use a desktop bridge so alerts and sync stay consistent across devices.

From the three-dot menu, then Settings, you can set or change PIN and auto-lock; export chat or alert history; open My app info (Bot ID, API key, FCM token for support); view My connection code (the code people enter when linking their mobile app to your hub); create a Desktop linking code (one-time code for your own Curax desktop program on a PC — see the next card); and reopen this Help.

• One-time code links your Curax desktop (PC) to this admin login.
• Enter it in the desktop app where it connects to your hub.
• For your own large-screen workflow — not for inviting mobile users.
• Patients use your invite or connection code from Connections or sign-up.
• Codes expire quickly and work once.

New hub alerts are delivered with FCM push when Google Play Services and notification permission allow it, even if the app is in the background. Keep battery optimizations off for Curax for reliable delivery. Open an alert from the list or from a notification to see details; use filters and bulk actions where the Alerts screen provides them.

- Disable battery optimization for Curax in Android settings. - Allow background data and lock-screen notifications. - After clearing app data or reinstalling, sign in again and reconnect relay if you use it. - Keep Play Services updated. - Use Export history before major changes if you need a local record.
